design.text: Open-label, single-arm, dose-escalation, dose-expansion study; patients received avapritinib 300 mg or 400 mg orally once daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

Patients received avapritinib 300 mg or 400 mg orally once daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

population.text: Adults with unresectable or metastatic GIST harboring a PDGFRalpha exon 18 mutation (including PDGFRalpha D842V), regardless of prior therapy.

citations.quote: Forty-three patients with unresectable or metastatic GIST who harbor PDGFR\alpha exon 18 mutations (including PDGFR\alpha D842V mutation), regardless of prior therapy (PDGFR\alpha exon 18 population) received starting doses of 300 or 400 mg avapritinib.

endpoint.text: Overall response rate (ORR), defined as confirmed CR or PR per mRECIST version 1.1 by central independent review.

citations.quote: In the dose expansion phase of the study (Part 2), the primary efficacy endpoint is ORR, defined as the rate of confirmed CR or PR by mRECIST version 1.1 as assessed by central independent review in the response evaluable population

n.text: Efficacy assessed in 43 patients with PDGFRalpha exon 18 mutations, including 38 with PDGFRalpha D842V mutations.

citations.quote: The assessment of efficacy was based on a total of 43 patients, including 38 patients with PDGFR\alpha D842V mutations.

result.text: In the 43-patient PDGFRalpha exon 18 population, ORR was 84% (95% CI: 69, 93), including 3 complete and 33 partial responses; median DOR not reached. In the PDGFRalpha D842V subgroup, ORR was 89% (95% CI: 75, 97).

citations.quote: The ORR of avapritinib in 43 patients with GIST harboring a PDGFR\alpha exon 18 mutation (38 of which were a D842V mutation) was 84% (95% CI: 69, 93). This included 3 complete and 33 partial responses. Median duration of response was not reached (range 1.9+ months to 20.3+ months). 61% of responders had a response that lasted \ge 6 months.
The effectiveness of avapritinib 300 mg daily for treatment of patients with metastatic or unresectable GIST harboring a PDGFR\alpha D842V mutation is established by the ORR of 89% (95% CI: 75, 97)

indication.text: AYVAKIT is indicated for the treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic GIST harboring a PDGFRA exon 18 mutation, including PDGFRA D842V mutations.

citations.quote: AYVAKIT is indicated for the treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic GIST harboring a platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha (PDGFRA) exon 18 mutation, including PDGFRA D842V mutations [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.1)].

target_moa.text: Avapritinib is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets PDGFRalpha and PDGFRalpha D842 mutants (and other exon 18 mutants) as well as multiple KIT exon 11, 11/17, and 17 mutants; these mutations can drive autophosphorylation and constitutive receptor activation supporting tumor cell proliferation.

citations.quote: Avapritinib is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets PDGFR\alpha, PDGFR\alpha D842 mutants, and other exon 18 mutants, as well as KIT and multiple KIT exon 11, 11/17, and 17 mutants; the established pharmacological class is kinase inhibitor.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=20%) were edema, nausea, fatigue/asthenia, cognitive impairment, vomiting, decreased appetite, diarrhea, hair color changes, increased lacrimation, abdominal pain, constipation, rash, and dizziness. Serious risks include CNS effects (58% of 335 patients) and intracranial hemorrhage.
